scope: Live Nemotron critic-role diagnostics on ten author-constructed synthetic review cases, two repeats. Not DSSAT policy performance, held-out accuracy, or training.
selection: Neither candidate promoted; v5 catches every constructed bad proposal but still rejects four of six expected-acceptable reviews. The shared default remains v1.
limitations: v5 wording was revised after inspecting v4 failures on these same development cases
Two stochastic repeats without a fixed sampling seed do not establish general accuracy
The existing critic reviews the planner before the coordinator; final coordinator errors are outside this review
source_commit identifies the base checkout; candidate code was uncommitted during diagnostics and actual source hashes are recorded per file
